text: Property Tax Relief COVID fund Grants distribution Digital Divide cmte BONNER CO DAILY BEE | Caroline Lobsinger | clobsinger@bonnercountydailybee.com CDA PRESS | Mike Patrick | mpatrick@cdapress.com | IDAHO COUNTY FREE PRESS | David Rauzi | drauzi@idahocountyfreepress.com OWYHEE AVALANCHE | Jon Brown | jon@owyheeavalanche.com POWER COUNTY PRESS / ABERDEEN TIMES | Brett Crompton | press1@press-times.com Subj: Seeking freelance opportunity Hi Caroline, I hope this finds you, your newsroom and community well amid the swell in coronavirus cases. Since the end of my internship this spring, I’ve stayed in the Treasure Valley and I am lucky to be working part-time as a production assistant at Idaho Public Television! Today my focus is on the state government’s response to COVID-19 rather than the legislature. However, there is far more news to follow than we are able to cover in a weekly 30-minute show. To get to the point, I want to get back into print writing. I had a fantastic experience writing for you and the other newspapers during the legislative session. Without much luck in the job market here, I am hoping to try my hand at freelance writing for a few outlets. Boise may be the seat of government, but the decisions made here will have far-reaching impacts in the months ahead. Today, the governor is unveiling guidance for reopening schools in the fall. I’m following that story and would be happy to do a writeup if you do not already have a reporter assigned to the topic. Please let me know if you are interested in a freelance or correspondent arrangement with a focus on coronavirus and state government. We can discuss deadlines, rates, and any story assignments you’d be interested in from the capital. Thanks!
